targets: Deep neck flexors (longus colli and capitis); upper cervical control

summary.en: Sitting tall, draw your head straight back as if making a double chin, keeping your eyes level.
summary.ru: Seedhe baith kar sar ko seedha peeche kheinchein jaise double chin bana rahe hon, nazar barabar rahe.

indications: Neck pain with forward head posture
contraindications: Dizziness, double vision or faintness during the movement
Unstable cervical spine or recent neck surgery unless cleared
Arm pain or tingling that increases with the movement

safety.en: Move gently — this is a small movement, not a hard push.
safety.ru: Aahista harkat karein — yeh chhoti harkat hai, zor se dhakka nahi.

safety.en: Stop and tell your physiotherapist if you feel dizzy or get tingling in your arms.
safety.ru: Chakkar aaye ya bazuon mein jhunjhuni ho to ruk kar physiotherapist ko batayein.

setup.en: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed and your eyes looking straight ahead.
setup.ru: Seedhe baith jayein, kandhe dheele, nazar seedhi samne.

steps.en: Keep your eyes level and gently glide your head straight back.
steps.ru: Nazar barabar rakhein aur sar ko aahista seedha peeche sarkayein.

steps.en: You should feel a light stretch at the base of the skull — do not tilt the head down.
steps.ru: Khopdi ke neeche halka stretch mehsoos hona chahiye — sar neeche na jhukayein.

steps.en: Hold for the count, then relax forward.
steps.ru: Count tak hold karein, phir relax karke aage aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you draw the head back; breathe normally while holding.
breathing.ru: Sar peeche late waqt saans bahar; hold mein normal saans.

mistakes.en: Tilting the chin down (nodding) instead of gliding back
mistakes.ru: Sar peeche karne ki jagah thori neeche jhuka dena

mistakes.en: Pushing hard or holding the breath
mistakes.ru: Zor se dhakka dena ya saans rokna

progressions: Supine nod with a hold (craniocervical flexion)
regressions: Do it lying on your back with support

say.en: Glide the head straight back — keep your eyes level.
say.ru: Sar ko seedha peeche sarkayein — nazar barabar rakhein.

text.en: Mistake: nodding the chin down instead of gliding straight back.
text.ru: Ghalti: sar seedha peeche karne ki jagah thori neeche jhuka dena.

targets: Cervical rotation range (rotators, sternocleidomastoid, deep neck muscles)

summary.en: Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder, return to the middle, then turn to the other side.
summary.ru: Aahista sar ko ek kandhe ki taraf modein, darmiyan mein layein, phir doosri taraf modein.

contraindications: Dizziness or visual disturbance on turning
Arm symptoms that increase with the movement
Unstable neck or recent surgery unless cleared

safety.en: Move only as far as is comfortable. Stop if you feel dizzy.
safety.ru: Sirf utna modein jitna aaram se ho. Chakkar aaye to ruk jayein.

setup.en: Sit tall with your hands resting in your lap.
setup.ru: Seedhe baith jayein, haath god mein rakhein.

steps.en: Turn your head slowly to the right, keeping your chin level.
steps.ru: Aahista sar daayen taraf modein, thori seedhi rakhte hue.

steps.en: Pause briefly at the end of the comfortable range.
steps.ru: Aaram dah range ke aakhir par thori der ruken.

steps.en: Come back to the middle and turn to the left.
steps.ru: Wapis darmiyan mein aayein aur baayen taraf modein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you turn, in as you come back.
breathing.ru: Modte waqt saans bahar, wapis aate waqt andar.

mistakes.en: Turning the shoulders with the head
mistakes.ru: Sar ke saath kandhe bhi modna

progressions: Add a gentle overpressure with the hand
Hold the end position for 5 s

say.en: Turn slowly to the right — as far as is comfortable.
say.ru: Aahista daayen taraf modein — jitna aaram se ho.

targets: Cervical lateral flexion; scalenes and upper trapezius flexibility

summary.en: Gently tilt your ear towards one shoulder without lifting the shoulder, then to the other side.
summary.ru: Kaan ko aahista kandhe ki taraf jhukayein, kandha upar na uthayein, phir doosri taraf.

contraindications: Arm pain, numbness or tingling that increases with the bend

safety.en: Do not pull with your hand — let the head tilt by its own weight.
safety.ru: Haath se kheinchein nahi — sar apne wazan se jhukne dein.

setup.en: Sit tall, shoulders relaxed and level.
setup.ru: Seedhe baith jayein, kandhe dheele aur barabar.

steps.en: Tilt your right ear towards your right shoulder.
steps.ru: Daayen kaan ko daayen kandhe ki taraf jhukayein.

steps.en: Keep the shoulders down and level; feel a gentle stretch on the other side.
steps.ru: Kandhe neeche aur barabar rakhein; doosri taraf halka stretch mehsoos hoga.

steps.en: Return to the middle and tilt to the left.
steps.ru: Wapis darmiyan mein aayein aur baayen taraf jhukayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you tilt; breathe normally while holding.
breathing.ru: Jhukte waqt saans bahar; hold mein normal saans.

mistakes.en: Lifting the shoulder to meet the ear
mistakes.ru: Kaan se milane ke liye kandha uthana

mistakes.en: Rotating the head as you tilt
mistakes.ru: Jhukte waqt sar ko mod dena

say.en: Tilt your ear towards your shoulder — shoulder stays down.
say.ru: Kaan kandhe ki taraf jhukayein — kandha neeche rahe.

name.ru: Upper trapezius stretch (gardan aur kandhe ke upar)

targets: Upper trapezius and levator scapulae flexibility

summary.en: Tilt your head away from the side to be stretched, with the same-side hand holding the chair to keep the shoulder down.
summary.ru: Jis side ko stretch karna ho us se door sar jhukayein, usi side ka haath kursi pakre taa ke kandha neeche rahe.

contraindications: Arm symptoms that increase with the stretch

safety.en: Feel a gentle stretch only — never a sharp pull or tingling.
safety.ru: Sirf halka stretch mehsoos ho — tez khinchao ya jhunjhuni nahi.

setup.en: Sit tall. Hold the side of the seat with the hand of the side being stretched.
setup.ru: Seedhe baith jayein. Jis side ko stretch karna hai us haath se kursi ka kinara pakar lein.

steps.en: Tilt your head away from the held hand.
steps.ru: Sar ko pakre hue haath se door jhukayein.

steps.en: Turn the nose slightly down towards the armpit for more stretch (optional).
steps.ru: Zyada stretch ke liye naak ko thora neeche baghal ki taraf karein (zaroori nahi).

steps.en: Hold, then return slowly.
steps.ru: Hold karein, phir aahista wapis aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe slowly and let the muscle relax as you breathe out.
breathing.ru: Aahista saans lein aur saans bahar chhodte waqt muscle dheela karein.

mistakes.ru: Pakre hue haath ka kandha upar uthna

say.en: Tilt away and let the neck muscle lengthen.
say.ru: Door jhukayein aur gardan ke muscle ko lamba hone dein.

name.ru: Supine nod (let kar sar ka nod)

targets: Deep cervical flexors (longus colli and capitis) — low-load endurance

summary.en: Lying on your back, make a small, slow "yes" nod and hold it gently without using the big neck muscles.
summary.ru: Peeth ke bal let kar chhota sa aahista "haan" wala nod karein aur bina bade muscles lagaye hold karein.

indications: Neck pain with deep neck flexor weakness
contraindications: Pain or arm symptoms that increase during the hold

safety.en: Use only light effort. If your neck tenses or shakes, rest.
safety.ru: Sirf halka zor lagayein. Gardan akar jaye ya kaampne lage to rest karein.

equipment: Small pillow or folded towel under the head

setup.en: Lie on your back with knees bent and a small pillow under your head so the neck is in a neutral position.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hue, sar ke neeche chhota takia taa ke gardan seedhi rahe.

steps.en: Gently nod your head as if saying yes — the chin moves towards the throat.
steps.ru: Sar ko aahista haan kehne ki tarah nod karein — thori gale ki taraf aaye.

steps.en: Hold the nod lightly. Do not lift your head or press hard.
steps.ru: Nod ko halke se hold karein. Sar uthayein nahi, zor se dabayein nahi.

steps.en: Slowly release back to the start.
steps.ru: Aahista wapis shuru ki position par aayein.

breathing.en: Keep breathing normally the whole time.
breathing.ru: Poore waqt normal saans lete rahein.

mistakes.en: Lifting the head off the pillow
Pushing the head back into the pillow
mistakes.ru: Sar ko takiye mein zor se dabana

mistakes.en: Using the jaw or neck muscles hard
mistakes.ru: Jabde ya gardan ke bade muscles zor se lagana

say.en: A small nod, and hold it lightly — don't lift the head.
say.ru: Chhota sa nod aur halke se hold karein — sar na uthayein.

name.ru: Chin tuck ke saath sar uthana

targets: Deep neck flexor endurance and strength

summary.en: Nod your chin in, then lift your head a few centimetres off the pillow and hold.
summary.ru: Pehle chin andar karein, phir sar ko takiye se thora sa uthayein aur hold karein.

indications: Progression of deep neck flexor training
Persistent neck pain after basic stabilisation
Return to desk or manual work
contraindications: Cannot yet hold a controlled supine nod for 10 s
Pain, dizziness or arm symptoms with the lift

safety.en: Lift only a little (about 2 cm). Stop if the chin pokes forward or the neck shakes.
safety.ru: Sirf thora (lagbhag 2 cm) uthayein. Chin aage nikle ya gardan kaampe to ruk jayein.

setup.en: Lie on your back with knees bent and a pillow under your head.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hue aur sar ke neeche takia.

steps.en: Nod the chin in first.
steps.ru: Pehle chin ko andar ki taraf nod karein.

steps.en: Keep the nod and lift your head just off the pillow.
steps.ru: Nod ko barkarar rakhein aur sar ko takiye se thora uthayein.

steps.en: Hold, then lower slowly.
steps.ru: Hold karein, phir aahista neeche aayein.

breathing.en: Keep breathing steadily — do not hold your breath.
breathing.ru: Barabar saans lete rahein — saans na rokein.

mistakes.en: The chin poking forward during the lift
mistakes.ru: Sar uthate waqt chin ka aage nikalna

say.en: Nod in, then lift the head just off the pillow.
say.ru: Pehle nod karein, phir sar ko takiye se thora uthayein.

name.ru: Shoulder blade squeeze (kandhon ko peeche milana)

targets: Middle trapezius, rhomboids and lower trapezius; upright posture endurance

summary.en: Draw your elbows back and gently squeeze your shoulder blades together, keeping your shoulders down.
summary.ru: Kohniyan peeche kheinchein aur kandhon ki haddiyan aapas mein milayein, kandhe neeche rahein.

indications: Neck and upper-back ache from desk work
contraindications: Pain at the front of the shoulder when drawing the elbows back

safety.en: Squeeze gently — do not arch the lower back or shrug.
safety.ru: Halke se milayein — kamar arch na karein, kandhe na uthayein.

setup.en: Sit tall with your elbows bent to 90° beside your body.
setup.ru: Seedhe baith jayein, kohniyan 90° par mudi hue jism ke paas.

steps.en: Draw both elbows back and slightly down.
steps.ru: Dono kohniyan peeche aur thori neeche kheinchein.

steps.en: Squeeze the shoulder blades together as if holding a pencil between them.
steps.ru: Kandhon ki haddiyan aise milayein jaise unke beech pencil pakri ho.

steps.en: Hold, then release slowly.
steps.ru: Hold karein, phir aahista chhor dein.

breathing.en: Breathe in as you open the chest, out as you release.
breathing.ru: Seena kholte waqt saans andar, chhorte waqt bahar.

say.en: Draw the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades.
say.ru: Kohniyan peeche kheinchein aur kandhon ki haddiyan milayein.
